name: OpenClaw nodes
summary: OpenClaw nodes are companion apps and headless hosts that connect to an OpenClaw gateway as peripherals and expose device commands to the agent. They add camera, screen recording, location, notifications, voice and command execution on the devices you pair, while messaging channels stay on the gateway.
facts: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux; watchOS and headless hosts
Gateway WebSocket with a pairing approval flow
Camera, screen, location, notifications, system.run, computer use, file transfer
goodFor: Giving one agent hands on many devices
Phone camera and location for a home-server agent
watchOut: system.run on nodes is powerful; scope approvals
Fast release cadence with frequent betas
